corrections.text: The article says the link between Forge and the Stainless wind-down comes only from The New Stack's headline and framing. In fact the body of The New Stack article argues that the Stainless wind-down "goes some way toward explaining why Cloudflare is making Forge open source", and notes that Cloudflare "doesn't name it specifically". Cloudflare's own blog post does not mention Stainless or Anthropic; it says only that "some [hosted products] have shut down entirely."

The headline's "as Anthropic Winds Down Stainless's Hosted Product" does not convey timing. TechCrunch reported the Anthropic acquisition and the plan to wind down Stainless's hosted products on May 18, 2026, more than four months before Cloudflare released Forge on September 28, 2026.
